jumlah_hk.description: Total Hari Kerja (hari dengan data OT=0 dan Hours > 5 jam, termasuk cuti/minggu/libur)
jumlah_hk.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TrxDate) as hk_count FROM "PR_TASKREGLN_ARC" WHERE EmpCode = ? AND TrxDate >= ? AND TrxDate < ? AND OT = 0 AND Hours > 5

kehadiran_detail.description: Get detailed daily attendance matrix for each employee using PR_TASKREGLN
kehadiran_detail.sql: SELECT DAY(TrxDate) as day_of_month, TrxDate, TaskCode, Hours, Amount, CASE WHEN TaskCode LIKE 'GA9129%' THEN 'cuti_tahunan' WHEN TaskCode LIKE 'GA9126%' THEN 'sakit' WHEN TaskCode LIKE 'GA9127%' THEN 'cuti_minggu' WHEN TaskCode LIKE 'GA9128%' THEN 'cuti_nasional' WHEN TaskCode LIKE 'GA%' THEN 'cuti_lain' WHEN DATEPART(weekday, TrxDate) = 1 THEN 'minggu' ELSE 'hadir' END as status FROM "PR_TASKREGLN_ARC" WHERE EmpCode = ? AND TrxDate >= ? AND TrxDate <= ? AND OT = 0 ORDER BY TrxDate

kehadiran_detail_byleave.description: Get detailed attendance data from leave records (PR_TASKREGLN)
kehadiran_detail_byleave.sql: SELECT DAY(trl.TrxDate) as day_of_month, trl.TrxDate as date, trl.TaskCode as leave_code, '' as leave_description, trl.Hours as hours, trl.Amount as amount, CASE WHEN trl.TaskCode LIKE 'GA9129%' THEN 'cuti_tahunan' WHEN trl.TaskCode LIKE 'GA9126%' THEN 'sakit' WHEN trl.TaskCode LIKE 'GA9127%' THEN 'cuti_minggu' WHEN trl.TaskCode LIKE 'GA9128%' THEN 'cuti_nasional' ELSE 'cuti_lain' END as leave_type FROM "PR_TASKREGLN_ARC" trl WHERE trl.EmpCode = ? AND trl.TrxDate >= ? AND trl.TrxDate <= ? AND (trl.TaskCode LIKE 'GA912%' OR trl.TaskCode LIKE 'GA913%') ORDER BY trl.TrxDate

cuti_tahunan.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TrxDate) as total_hari_cuti FROM "PR_TASKREGLN_ARC" WHERE "EmpCode" = ? AND "TrxDate" >= ? AND "TrxDate" < ? AND "TaskCode" LIKE 'GA9129%' AND OT = 0

cuti_tahunan_detail.sql: SELECT DAY(trl.TrxDate) as day_of_month, trl.TrxDate as date, trl.TaskCode, '' as Description, trl.Hours, trl.Amount FROM "PR_TASKREGLN_ARC" trl WHERE trl.EmpCode = ? AND trl.TrxDate >= ? AND trl.TrxDate <= ? AND trl.TaskCode LIKE 'GA9129%' AND trl.OT = 0 ORDER BY trl.TrxDate

cuti_sakit.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TrxDate) as total_cuti FROM "PR_TASKREGLN_ARC" WHERE "EmpCode" = ? AND "TrxDate" >= ? AND "TrxDate" < ? AND "TaskCode" LIKE 'GA9126%' AND OT = 0

cuti_sakit_detail.sql: SELECT DAY(trl.TrxDate) as day_of_month, trl.TrxDate as date, trl.TaskCode, '' as Description, trl.Hours, trl.Amount FROM "PR_TASKREGLN_ARC" trl WHERE trl.EmpCode = ? AND trl.TrxDate >= ? AND trl.TrxDate <= ? AND trl.TaskCode LIKE 'GA9126%' AND trl.OT = 0 ORDER BY trl.TrxDate

cuti_minggu.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TrxDate) as total_cuti_minggu FROM "PR_TASKREGLN_ARC" WHERE "EmpCode" = ? AND "TrxDate" >= ? AND "TrxDate" < ? AND DATEPART(weekday, TrxDate) = 1 AND OT = 0

cuti_minggu_detail.sql: SELECT DAY(trl.TrxDate) as day_of_month, trl.TrxDate as date, trl.TaskCode, '' as Description, trl.Hours, trl.Amount FROM "PR_TASKREGLN_ARC" trl WHERE trl.EmpCode = ? AND trl.TrxDate >= ? AND trl.TrxDate <= ? AND DATEPART(weekday, trl.TrxDate) = 1 AND trl.OT = 0 ORDER BY trl.TrxDate

cuti_nasional.description: Get count of national holiday days from PR_TASKREGLN joined with HR_GPH
cuti_nasional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT trl.TrxDate) as total_cuti_nasional FROM "PR_TASKREGLN_ARC" trl INNER JOIN "HR_GPH" gph ON trl.TrxDate = gph.HolidayDate AND gph.Status = 1 WHERE trl.EmpCode = ? AND trl.TrxDate >= ? AND trl.TrxDate < ? AND trl.OT = 0

cuti_nasional_detail.description: Get detailed national holiday leave records
cuti_nasional_detail.sql: SELECT DAY(trl.TrxDate) as day_of_month, trl.TrxDate as date, trl.TaskCode, gph.Description as Description, trl.Hours, trl.Amount, gph.IsRegionPH FROM "PR_TASKREGLN_ARC" trl INNER JOIN "HR_GPH" gph ON trl.TrxDate = gph.HolidayDate AND gph.Status = 1 WHERE trl.EmpCode = ? AND trl.TrxDate >= ? AND trl.TrxDate <= ? AND trl.OT = 0 ORDER BY trl.TrxDate

kehadiran_hadir.description: Get count of regular working days (non-GA TaskCode, non-Sunday, non-Holiday)
kehadiran_hadir.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT trl.TrxDate) as total_hadir FROM "PR_TASKREGLN_ARC" trl WHERE trl.EmpCode = ? AND trl.TrxDate >= ? AND trl.TrxDate < ? AND trl.OT = 0 AND trl.TaskCode NOT LIKE 'GA%' AND DATEPART(weekday, trl.TrxDate) != 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HR_GPH gph WHERE gph.HolidayDate = trl.TrxDate AND gph.Status = 1)
